description.en: Technical notes on NEXTBODY Hoop, the NEXTBODY App, and MCP — written from claims already on the product site.
description.zh: 关于 NEXTBODY Hoop、NEXTBODY App 与 MCP 的技术说明，内容只依据产品站已发布表述。

lede.en: Short technical docs for HOOP, the App, and how MCP talks to assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude. Nothing here invents medical claims.
lede.zh: 关于 HOOP、App，以及 MCP 如何对接 ChatGPT、Claude 等助手的短篇技术说明。不另作医疗宣称。

post_title.en: How NEXTBODY MCP connects health data to ChatGPT and Claude
post_title.zh: NEXTBODY MCP 如何把健康数据接到 ChatGPT 与 Claude

post_excerpt.en: You sign in and authorise it. Assistants can read only your account. Meal logging stays off until you turn it on.
post_excerpt.zh: 需本人登录并授权。助手只能读你自己的账号。记录餐食默认关闭，要你打开才会用。

disclaimer.en: HOOP and the NEXTBODY App are not medical devices and are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. Data, tips and suggestions are for reference only.
disclaimer.zh: HOOP 与 NEXTBODY App 均非医疗器械，不用于诊断、治疗、治愈或预防任何疾病。数据、提示与建议仅供参考。
